brief: Leadership and reorganisation news for MK's systemic banks originates upstream at the parents: NLB (Ljubljana), Steiermärkische Sparkasse/Erste (Graz/Vienna), Türkiye Halk Bankası (Ankara, via KAP), ProCredit Holding (Frankfurt) and Central Cooperative Bank (Sofia), with Silk Road Capital (Zurich) behind Silk Road Bank; OTP has no MK presence. The strongest, openly crawlable feeds are NLB's press-release and investor-news sections, ProCredit Holding's ad-hoc news and annual/disclosure PDFs, and Steiermärkische's Graz press archive, while the Turkish and Bulgarian legs require direct polling of KAP and BSE-Sofia X3News rather than web search. The MK-side confirmation layer — nlb.mk's Соопштенија за јавност, NBRM согласност decisions, and SEINet issuer filings — is essential because an appointment only takes effect on NBRM approval, and MK-language trade media (bankarstvo.mk, kapital.mk, faktor.mk) reliably surface moves that parents do not headline. Main risks are JS-gated disclosure platforms (SEINet, KAP), unconfirmed news paths on the two subsidiary sites, and stale ownership metadata in commercial aggregators.
